note: Input begins with the PROXY v2 signature 0x0D0A0D0A, so the dispatcher routes to parse_proxy_protocol_v2. This is the format gate confirming the candidate is accepted as a PROXY v2 header.
hdr->len (bytes 14-15) is 0x0024 = 36, so size = 16 + 36 = 52. The actual input buffer is only 16 bytes, so the claimed header size exceeds the available buffer capacity.
invariant: decoded length must not exceed destination capacity

note: The bounds check compares size (52) against sizeof(struct proxy_header_v2) (52), not against the actual 16-byte buffer length. Since 52 > 52 is false, the oversized header passes validation.

With fam == TCP4, the parser reads hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr at offset 16-19, which lies beyond the 16-byte input buffer. This out-of-bounds read is the sanitizer-visible memory access caused by the unchecked header length.
